title: OpenGateway
brief: OpenGateway is a unified LLM gateway — one OpenAI-compatible endpoint for models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Z.ai, Moonshot AI, and more, with automatic retries, failover chains, live request inspection, and team keys with prepaid credits and spend caps. Shared via its model pages for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Eco and Ultrafast, two serving routes of the already-listed DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
details: OpenGateway is a unified LLM gateway: point any OpenAI SDK at its single endpoint (`https://apis.opengateway.ai/v1`) and switch models by changing one string, with routing, authentication, retries, and response normalisation handled for you. Its homepage lists models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, Google Vertex, xAI, Moonshot AI, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Z.ai, Alibaba, and Sionic AI, including accelerated "ultrafast" routes such as `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-ultrafast` and `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-ultrafast`. It adds a Grafana-style Live Tail for debugging calls in flight, configurable failover chains that reroute on 429, 5xx, or timeouts, per-request latency, token, and cost analytics, and team keys with roles, prepaid credits, and auto-pause spend caps; the homepage publishes no fee schedule or credit terms. It was shared in #providers via its model pages for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Eco and Ultrafast, two serving routes of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; those pages are client-rendered, and the Eco route isn't shown on the homepage (unverified beyond the Discord embed).
